messages:
emma: Quick UX flag: our in-console help panel title says 'Guides' but the site and nav use 'Docs'. new users are confused in support tickets. ryan: saw that too. where is it showing 'Guides'? screenshot? emma: top-right help -> side panel. placeholder says 'Search Guides' and keyboard shortcut mentions Guides too. priya: agree we should standardize. my vote: make the panel header 'Docs' and keep 'Guides' as a subsection for step-by-step tutorials. sam: +1. also propose adding 'Open in Console' links inside docs articles when theres a matching console route. right now they only point to other docs pages. docs-bot: lexicon scan complete: occurrences found -> Docs: 18 (docs site + nav), Guides: 5 (console panel + onboarding), Documentation/Documentation: 2. export: /shared/design/lexicon_unify.csv emma: thanks bot. action list idea: 1) change panel header to 'Docs', 2) update search placeholder to 'Search Docs', 3) add per-article CTA 'Open in Console' (visible to users with console access), 4) add router redirects from /guides/* -> /docs/*, 5) standardize analytics keys. ryan: analytics note: use lowercase 'docs' in event keys. suggested keys: docs.panel_open, docs.search_query, docs.open_console_click. priya: accessibility notes: when drawer opens, focus should jump to the h2 with id and screenreader announcement should say "Dialog: Docs". CTA needs aria-label like "Open Model routing in Console (opens in new tab)" and include rel=\"noopener\". Also ensure the button is reachable via keyboard. sam: for redirects, example nginx rule: ``` location ~ ^/guides/(.*)$ { return 301 /docs/$1; } ``` For SPA client-side: router rule that maps /guides/* -> /docs/* and emit deprecation event once per session. emma: rollout plan: canary 5% orgs -> 25% -> 100% if metrics look good. measure search term success: increment in 'docs' searches and drop in 'guides' queries; monitor support mentions for 2 weeks. ryan: I'll own the console change (header + placeholder + shortcut). ETA: Wednesday EOD. I'll include smoke tests. priya: I'll take a11y validation and update onboarding copy strings. sam: I'll add per-article CTA and ensure it's gated by permission check. I'll also add telemetry payload including destination_route and user_role. docs-bot: created tasks on board: Panel copy update, Docs CTA, Redirects, Analytics rename, A11y pass. emma: example CTA markup for the PR: ``` Open in Console ``` priya: example panel dialog markup for accessibility: ```

Docs

Opens the corresponding console page in a new tab

``` ryan: perfect. I'll post PR link in channel when ready and include screenshots. emma: thanks all :raised_hands: closing once PR merged and canary metrics look good.
